newsitem.title: USA: Air Products to lead hydrogen project team.
newsitem.headline: Air Products to lead hydrogen project team.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Department of Energy named the company to spearhead development of technology to reduce the cost of producing hydrogen from natural gas.

The company said it will lead teams from eight other companies and two universities in the $84 million project to develop a new ionic ceramic membrane technology. It said the technology is expected to reduce the cost of producing transportation-grade liquid fuels and premium chemicals.
The Energy Department will share $30 million of the cost, the company said.
The project will be conducted in three phases over eight years, leading to the construction of a pre-commercial scale plant, Air Products said.
